questions.title: Who will score the opening goal when Real Betis host Real Madrid in La Liga in September 2026?
questions.background: The opening goalscorer is the player officially credited with the first goal of the match.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : La Liga's official match record, corroborated by reliable match reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the player credited with the earliest goal in the September 2026 La Liga fixture hosted by Real Betis against Real Madrid. Disallowed goals do not count. If the match finishes goalless, resolve as “No goalscorer.” Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Real Madrid finished 2nd in 2025-26 (77 GF) and hired José Mourinho on June 13, 2026, while Real Betis finished 5th (59 GF, strong home record); expected goals (~1.48 RM, ~1.06 Betis) imply an ~8.6-9% chance of a 0-0 draw ('No goalscorer'). Conditional on a goal, RM score first ~58% of the time, led by back-to-back Pichichi winner Kylian Mbappé (25 of RM's 77 goals in 31 apps, primary penalty taker) and Vinícius Júnior (16 goals in 36 apps), with Jude Bellingham likely to rebound from 6 goals in 28 apps. For Betis (~42% share of first goal), top scorer Cucho Hernández (11 goals in 32 apps) leads, leaving 49% across the remaining outfield players (including Abde Ezzalzouli, Antony, Gonzalo García, and summer signings).

local_articles.title: Troy Parrott to undergo medical at Real Betis ahead of €20m deal
local_articles.snippet: Champions League football and the opportunity to work with the 72-year-old Manuel Pellegrini has Troy Parrott on the cusp of completing a €20-million move from AZ Alkmaar to Real Betis in Spain. Parrott is reportedly finalising the terms of a five-year contract to swap the Dutch Eredivisie for La Liga on an initial fee of €16 million, with add-ons of around €4 million. The figures indicate a €12-million profit for AZ after they paid Tottenham Hotspur €8 million for the Republic of Ireland international in 2024. The 24-year-old attracted interest from West Ham and across Europe following his breakout season for club and country, scoring 37 goals, including a hat-trick against Hungary in Budapest last March in the World Cup playoff. local_articles.title: The wedding, secret lunch and Barcelona coup: How Rodri slipped from Real Madrid’s grasp
local_articles.snippet: The confetti from Spain's FIFA World Cup triumph had barely settled this summer when speculation emerged that Golden Ball winner Rodri was expected to leave Manchester City for Real Madrid. The Spain captain had even described a move to the Santiago Bernabéu as a “dream move”. But plenty changed in the weeks that followed. Almost two months after Spain beat Argentina in New Jersey, Rodri officially signed for a new Spanish club, but it was not Real Madrid. Barcelona beat their arch-rivals to secure the midfielder's signing from Manchester City in a deal that could be worth up to €76.5 million (£65.3 million; $87.8 million) including add-ons. By late July, rumours surrounding Rodri's move to Madrid were gathering pace. questions.title: Which Brazilian Supreme Court justice, if any, will order Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues suspended during September 2026?
questions.background: Brazil’s Federal Police investigates federal crimes, and its leadership can be subject to judicial orders.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Public orders from Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court or contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations identifying the justice responsible. Resolution Conditions : Identify the justice who issues an order during September 2026 suspending Andrei Rodrigues from his position as Federal Police chief. If multiple qualifying orders are issued, use the earliest publicly announced order. Accepted Answer Format : The justice’s full name. If no qualifying order is issued by September 30, 2026, answer “None”.
questions.current_reasoning: A Supreme Federal Court (STF) justice suspending the sitting Federal Police Director-General would be an extraordinary, historically rare intervention, and Andrei Rodrigues described PF-STF relations as harmonious in March 2026, making 'None' the modal outcome (~50%). However, acute friction surrounds the Banco Master / Daniel Vorcaro inquiry heading into Brazil's October 2026 presidential election: rapporteur André Mendonça (Bolsonaro appointee) already issued a February 2026 order restricting Rodrigues's access to case files, making Mendonça the clear #1 justice if a suspension occurs (~24%). Smaller probabilities go to Dias Toffoli (clashed directly with PF over Vorcaro phone evidence), Gilmar Mendes (frequent critic of PF overreach), and Alexandre de Moraes (~7% left on other justices including TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques).

questions.title: What immigration status will the Trump administration seek to require for noncitizens to be included in the 2030 US census?
questions.background: The decennial US census affects representation in the House of Representatives and the allocation of federal funding. Trump has previously advocated changing which immigrants are counted.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Department of Commerce proposal, or reliable contemporaneous reporting explicitly describing its eligibility rules for the 2030 census. Resolution Conditions : Resolve upon the administration's next formal proposal specifying eligibility for the 2030 census, provided it is published by September 30, 2026. Identify the immigration status the proposal requires noncitizens to hold to be included. Publication is sufficient; implementation or judicial approval is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the required immigration status, in one to three words.
questions.current_reasoning: In August 2025 Trump instructed the Commerce Department to exclude people in the U.S. illegally from the census, Commerce stated it would analyze data to reflect 'legal residents', and in early 2026 the Census Bureau pivoted its 2030 field test to ACS citizenship questions. A formal 2026 Commerce Department 2030 residence-criteria proposal requiring an immigration status for noncitizens will most likely set the threshold either at permanent domicile—'Lawful permanent resident' (~35%, excluding temporary visa holders as well as undocumented immigrants)—or at general legal eligibility excluding only undocumented immigrants ('Lawful status' ~26%, 'Lawful presence' ~17%, or 'Legal residence' ~8%), with a small chance (~3%) of limiting noncitizen inclusion strictly to 'U.S. national' (~11% on other formulations).

questions.title: Who will control Yemen's Mayun Island on September 11, 2026?
questions.background: Mayun, also known as Perim, is an island in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. Its location makes it strategically important for maritime traffic.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press or Al Jazeera identifying which military actor exercises territorial control over Mayun Island. Resolution Date : Resolve according to confirmed control on September 11, 2026. Territorial control means physical possession of the island, not merely a sovereignty claim or the ability to threaten nearby shipping. Accepted Answer Format : The commonly used name of the armed group, government, or coalition controlling the island.
questions.current_reasoning: Following the dramatic Jan 2026 Saudi intervention in southern Yemen that ousted UAE-backed STC leader Aidarous al-Zubaidi, dissolved the STC, and transferred southern military installations—including Mayun (Perim) Island—out of UAE control into pro-government command under direct Saudi oversight, the Yemeni government / Saudi-led coalition / Saudi Arabia represent the status quo (0.64 combined across reporting labels). However, the Houthis control the adjacent mainland coast and pose a serious risk of seizing or attacking Mayun Island in Bab al-Mandeb during summer/early September 2026 (consistent with heightened Houthi escalation risk). A smaller tail (0.08) remains for UAE operational control or re-entry.

questions.title: Which Ukrainian city away from the eastern and southern front lines will experience repeated Russian strikes on fuel stations by September 11, 2026?
questions.background: Russian attacks have repeatedly hit fuel stations near Ukraine’s eastern and southern battle lines. The spread of this targeting pattern to cities farther from the fighting would broaden its impact on civilians.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official Ukrainian municipal statements and reliable contemporaneous reporting citing local authorities. Resolution Conditions : Identify the Ukrainian city outside the eastern and southern frontline areas where Russian attacks are confirmed to have directly struck fuel stations on at least two separate days between September 1 and September 11, 2026. Reports of isolated attacks or incidental damage to nearby stations do not qualify. Accepted Answer Format : The name of the city.
questions.current_reasoning: Since April 2026, Russia has systematically targeted nearly 140 Ukrainian fuel stations using Geran-2 and AI-guided V2U drones, concentrated near frontline oblasts (Kharkiv, Sumy, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson) but already spilling into rear areas including Kyiv (hit June 2, explicitly highlighted by NaftoRynok), Chernihiv oblast (June 7–8), Odesa oblast, Dnipropetrovsk oblast, and Poltava energy infrastructure. Excluding eastern/southern frontline cities, Kyiv is the top candidate (26%) due to its dense fuel retail network, frequent Shahed waves, and thorough municipal reporting, followed by key fuel/logistics hubs Odesa (15%), northern border-adjacent Chernihiv (13%), central energy hub Poltava (10%), and Dnipro (9%), leaving 27% across other rear cities such as Lviv, Cherkasy, Kremenchuk, Vinnytsia, and Kryvyi Rih.

questions.title: Who will win the men's 5,000 metres at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in September 2026?
questions.background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled to take place in Budapest in September 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : World Athletics' official results or contemporaneous reporting from a reputable news organization. Resolution : Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the men's 5,000-metre final at the September 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship, once the final result is announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning athlete's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship men's 5,000m in Budapest (Sept 11) is a straight 12-man final with a $150,000 top prize and no pacemakers. Paris 2024 Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen and 2025 Tokyo World 5,000m champion Cole Hocker are already auto-qualified and stand out as co-favorites in a likely tactical kick finish (with slight uncertainty over Ingebrigtsen's 2026 health/form and whether Hocker doubles). Yomif Kejelcha's move to the marathon (1:59:41 in London) reduces his track likelihood, leaving Grant Fisher, Hagos Gebrhiwet, Berihu Aregawi, and the remaining ~7 qualifiers (30% combined) as key challengers.

questions.title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
questions.background: Goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma and his partner were attacked during a burglary at their Paris home in July 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The defendant's name as publicly reported.
questions.current_reasoning: In May 2026, a Paris examining magistrate ordered three adult defendants to stand trial before the Paris Criminal Court (tribunal correctionnel) over the July 2023 Donnarumma home-jacking (two minors go separately to juvenile court, and a sixth suspect died in prison). Ilyas Kherbouch ('Ganito', 21) is overwhelmingly favored to receive the longest sentence: prosecutors allege he was the principal mastermind from Villepinte prison, he already received 7 years in Dec 2024 for the Simone Zanoni home-jacking (triggering statutory recidivism), escaped prison for 13 days in March 2026, and is the sole defendant publicly named in full. Co-mastermind Khyan M. ('Kiki', 21) carries ~18-20% risk of the top sentence if Kherbouch's denial partially succeeds, split between reporting as 'Khyan M.' (10%) and his currently unpublished full surname or the anonymized third adult defendant.

questions.title: Who will win the women's javelin title at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the athlete declared the women's javelin champion at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest, according to the official World Athletics results. Resolution Date : 2026-09-19 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the athlete's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: On May 23, 2026 in Xiamen, 18-year-old Chinese prodigy Yan Ziyi shocked the sport with a 71.74m Diamond League victory—the second-furthest women's javelin throw in history and 6.74m ahead of 2026's #2 mark (Sigrid Borge's 65.00m). In an 8-woman Budapest Ultimate Championship field, Yan is the clear favorite, though tempered by youth, javelin volatility, and still needing to seal top-8/DL qualification. Auto-qualified Olympic champion Haruka Kitaguchi, 2025 world #1 & DL winner Elina Tzengko, 67m-talent Adriana Vilagoš, and 2x World bronze medalist Mackenzie Little lead the chasing pack, with 21% left for auto-qualified 2025 World champion Juleisy Angulo, Sigrid Borge, Anete Sietiņa, and others.

questions.title: Who will win Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election?
questions.background: Okinawa is Japan's southernmost prefecture, where the presence of US military bases is a major political issue.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official results announced by Okinawa's election authorities, either directly or as reported by reliable news organizations. Resolution : The question resolves when the winner of Okinawa's 2026 gubernatorial election is officially announced. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Okinawa's September 13, 2026 gubernatorial race is effectively a two-way contest between two-term anti-Henoko incumbent Denny Tamaki (66) and unified conservative challenger Genta Koja (42, former Naha deputy mayor backed by the LDP and local business groups), with independent Takamasa Kinoshita a minor candidate. An internal LDP poll reported May 31 showed Tamaki leading Koja by roughly 10 points, bolstered by strong popularity among women voters, Rengo Okinawa's June 17 endorsement, and All Okinawa's three consecutive gubernatorial wins since 2014. However, Koja has a substantial upset path after the LDP swept all four Okinawa lower-house districts in February 2026, Komeito's Okinawa chapter ruled out supporting Tamaki (weighing Koja endorsement or free vote as of June 24), and Tamaki faces third-term fatigue plus backlash from March's fatal Henoko protest boat capsizing.
